duṃ duṃ rakṣa:bod skad du/mu stegs kyi yig rgod nyi shu rtsa gcig 'di/'gos pa'i nad thams cad srung ba 'di'o/ /gcig tu 'brum nag kha shor thub/gnyi

tei:div.tei:p: duṃ duṃ rakṣa: bod skad du/ mu stegs kyi yig rgod nyi shu rtsa gcig 'di/ 'gos pa'i nad thams cad srung ba 'di'o// gcig tu 'brum nag kha shor thub/ gnyis su rgya nad mig ser thub/ gsum du nywa gas mgo gas thub/ bzhi ru nag po sum sgril thub/ tsha rims dmar bshal mgo gas nywa gas thub par the tshom med/ stag gzig mi mthun yams nad zlog /'di brgya rtsa brgyad kyis rab gnas bya/ ye dharmā gsum brjod/ rdzas kyi rim pa ni/ ga pur/ bzang drug /shu dag /gla rtsi/ gu gul/ mu zi/ btsan dug /a ru ra gser mdog /shing kun/ sgog skya/ yungs dkar nag /gi waṃ/ ba bla'o// bzhi pa yig rgod lhag chad med par bri/ mjug nas yar dril g.yogs nag po bya/ mu stegs lo thub nag po'i rgyud nas gsungs pa'i gnam lcags rdo rje'o// shu bhaṃ/ 'di zhang khrom gter ma yin par grags kyang gnyis ka la lung rgyun med/ thub nges lag blangs mar 'dug /

yig rgod nyer gcig btags pa'i phan yon ni/ khrag bshal mgo gas nywa gas sogs// dmar bshal 'brum bu la sogs mgo gas rims// rgyug 'gyel 'gos nad thams cad thub bo// rdzas ni/ a ru nag chung*/ ru rta/ shu dag /dom mkhris/ gla rtsi/ bzang drug /ba bla/ yung ba/ shing kun 'di rnams brtson la/ rab gnas sngags ni/ bswo dbang chung bhi sha rab bhuddha phaṭa/ brgya rtsa brgyad kyis rab gnas bya/ stobs chen mthu chen rdzogs so/// /
